mapper.select: SELECT request_no, sitter_email, parent_email, request_date, time_slot, message, status, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_babysitter_request WHERE sitter_email = #{sitterEmail} ORDER BY reg_time DESC
SELECT request_no, sitter_email, parent_email, request_date, time_slot, message, status, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_babysitter_request WHERE parent_email = #{parentEmail} ORDER BY reg_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_babysitter_request WHERE sitter_email = #{sitterEmail} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
SELECT request_date FROM tbl_babysitter_request WHERE sitter_email = #{sitterEmail} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_babysitter_request (sitter_email, parent_email, request_date, time_slot, message, status) VALUES (#{sitterEmail}, #{parentEmail}, #{requestDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_babysitter_request SET request_date = #{requestDate}, time_slot = #{timeSlot}, message = #{message}, mod_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_no = #{requestNo}
UPDATE tbl_babysitter_request SET status = #{status}, mod_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_no = #{requestNo}
